one_line: An AI-powered visual breakdown of facial structure and feature refinements leading into an offer for a personalized facial analysis dossier.

hook.what_happens: A portrait of a woman is shown, splitting into three vertical panels with text stating 'Same woman. Same face.' and 'One face, three impressions.'
hook.why_it_works: Creates instant visual curiosity by showing how subtle structural and feature edits dramatically alter perception.

shots.description: Portrait split into three panels demonstrating subtle visual variations.
Center line and grid overlays highlight structural and proportional breakdown.
Zoomed view of lower face comparing original vs facelift jawline definition.
Split face cycling through individual facial features (brows, eyes, nose, lips, hair).
Full face showing interconnected feature lines.
Three full portraits displayed side-by-side for direct comparison.
Horizontal split dividing upper feature edits from lower structural edits.
Three portraits side-by-side with overlaid numbers 1, 2, 3.
Interactive mobile UI demo scrolling through a personalized facial dossier report.
Final call to action screen featuring search bar entry.

onscreen_text.text: BROWS EYES NOSE LIPS SKIN HAIR

transcript.text: So why do these three versions look so different?
What changes is the structure, the proportions, the details.
In version two, a facelift reshapes her lower face.
A tighter jawline, a more defined profile.
Skin and hair change how the whole face reads.
None of these exist in isolation.
Now compare all three. The original, the facelift, the refined features.
And interestingly, the biggest change isn't always the whole face.
Beauty is subjective. Which do you prefer: one, two, or three?
Want to understand your own face? Refina's personalized 22-page facial analysis maps your features, your strengths, and what you may want to refine.

narrative_arc: Presents a visual puzzle of one face rendered in three distinct ways.
Deconstructs the face into structural vs feature-level adjustments.
Compares all versions and prompts audience interaction.
Transitions to product solution offering personalized facial analysis reports.

cta.what: Prompt to search 'Refina AI' and discover personalized facial analysis.

subjects: Unidentified female model used for AI facial analysis visualization
what_makes_it_work: Analytical visuals build technical credibility before presenting the product offer.
Interactive poll element drives engagement midway through the ad.
